title: Digital modes, ARQ and FEC
blurb: Choose the right digital mode, read a waterfall, and explain codes, ARQ and forward error correction.

G8C02.why: **WSPR** is a low-power beacon mode used to see where HF propagation is open.
G8C02.trap: PSK31 and MFSK16 carry messages. SSB-SC is a voice mode.

G8C03.why: The packet **header** holds the routing and handling information, such as where it comes from and goes to.

G8C04.why: Baudot is a **5-bit code** with extra start and stop bits around each character.
G8C04.trap: A 7-bit code with parity is ASCII-style, not Baudot.

G8C05.why: A **NAK** says the packet had an error, so the sender must **retransmit** it.
G8C05.trap: A received-OK reply is an ACK, the opposite.

G8C06.why: If too many attempts fail, the ARQ link gives up: **the connection is dropped**.

G8C07.why: **FT8** is the narrow-band mode built to decode signals far below the noise.

G8C08.why: Varicode gives common lower-case characters short codes, so **capitals use longer sequences** and slow the text.
G8C08.trap: Plain (BPSK) PSK31 has no error correction, and capitals are not sent at higher power.

G8C09.why: Each node links to several others, so if one fails a packet can still arrive **via an alternate node**.
G8C09.trap: More nodes add routes, not signal strength.

G8C10.why: FEC adds **redundant information** to the data, so the receiver can fix errors without a resend.
G8C10.trap: A parity bit only detects an error, and Varicode is a character set.

G8C11.why: The two FSK frequencies are called **mark and space**.
G8C11.trap: Dot and dash describe Morse code, on and off describe keying.

G8C12.why: PSK31 sends characters in **Varicode**, a variable-length code.

G8C13.why: Vertical lines either side of a data signal on a waterfall indicate **overmodulation**.
G8C13.trap: Overmodulation is too much drive, not too little.

G8C14.why: On a waterfall, frequency runs **across**, time runs **down**, and signal strength is the **brightness**.

G8C15.why: FT8 reports are **signal-to-noise in dB**, measured as if in a 2.5 kHz bandwidth. +3 means 3 dB above the noise.
G8C15.trap: It is not an S-unit and not dB over S9.

G8C16.why: **DMR, D-STAR and System Fusion** carry digitized voice. FT8, WSPR and Winlink modes carry data.
